run_visualize_reconstruction: run the visualize_reconstruction script to generate flyaround videos from a trained Implicitron model checkpoint
run_visualize_reconstruction_with_custom: run visualize_reconstruction with a spiral camera path and 40 evaluation cameras for a specific experiment directory
run_visualize_reconstruction_with_restri: run visualize_reconstruction restricted to a single sequence name and output to a custom directory
run_visualize_reconstruction_with_shuffl: run visualize_reconstruction with shuffled sequences and a custom trajectory scale for varied visualization
run_visualize_reconstruction_with_custom: run visualize_reconstruction with custom render and video sizes for higher resolution output
